package.description: Application for intuitive file sharing between devices.

en-US.description: Application for intuitive file sharing between devices.
en-US.longDescription:
Dragit helps you share files between computers in the same network.

- useful when you want to send file from one computer to another
- requires no configuration
- single purpose - does only one thing and nothing more
- works on Linux and Windows machines
- automatically checks the firewalld config on Linux distros and offers opening
  the ports
en-US.name: Dragit
